messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate in us-west-2. error_rate=7.2% (5min), latency_p95=1.8s, increased timeouts. Pager notified. Incident ID INC-2143

pagerduty-bot: Paging on-call: sara (SRE) — escalation level 1. Trigger: auth-service 429 cascade -> proxy 502/504 spikes.

sara (SRE): I’m on it. Quick status: is this customer-facing traffic only or internal too?

mike (infra): Seen from infra dashboards — traffic spike from a single tenant that hit burst quota change earlier today. Lots of 429s on quota-gateway which then caused retries into backend, producing 5xx.

john (platform): Confirming: a quota policy change rolled out at 09:12 UTC that tightened per-tenant concurrent limit. Looks like it applied to a range of customers including a high-QPS tenant.

sara (SRE): Ok, priority: stop cascade, reduce retries, restore previous quota config. Elli, can support draft message for affected customers?

ellie (support): On it. Need list of affected customers and ETA. Can we patch by rolling back?

mike (infra): Rollback path: revert the feature-flag that enabled new quota enforcement. I’ll stage a revert to the policy service and flip it if tests look clean.

sara (SRE): Also immediate mitigation: 1) set global soft-throttle at API gateway to shed low-priority traffic, 2) disable aggressive client retries at proxy layer, 3) route traffic to fallback model variant (smaller model) for best-effort throughput.

john (platform): Routing rule ready. Adding a sticky fallback route for tenants exceeding quota errors. Will deploy the route change now. Command: ```curl -X POST https://route-api.internal/rules -d '{"match":"quota_error","action":"route:fallback-small"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'```

mike (infra): Running rollback dry-run on staging. If OK, will flip in 2 mins. Running: ```kubectl rollout undo deploy/quota-service -n platform --to-revision=42```

sara (SRE): Reduce retry budget: ```splunk-query | rate_limit --proxy.retries=1``` — apply to proxy config. Devops, please patch.

devops-bot: patch applied to proxy pool: max_retries=1 for /v1/generate. New config hot-reloaded.

sara (SRE): Good. Observability: enable verbose logs for quota-gateway trace for next 15m. Increase retention of error traces.

incident-bot: INC-2143 created, severity=P1, responders=[sara (SRE), mike (infra), john (platform)]. Runbook: /runbooks/quota-cascade.md

mike (infra): Revert completed and quota-service back to prior config. Metrics: 429 rate dropped ~80% in 1m. But still seeing 502s from model-backend due to backlog.

sara (SRE): Backlog mitigation: scale model serving by +30% in us-west-2 for 10m. Command: ```autoscaler scale --pool=model-usw2 --percent=+30```

john (platform): Routing to fallback-small now live for ~5% of traffic, will expand to 25% if error rate doesn't decline.

ellie (support): Drafted customer note: "We detected a quota configuration change that briefly reduced throughput and caused errors for some requests. We rolled back the change and applied mitigations; normal service is being restored. We will follow up with root cause and remediation." Want list of impacted org ids to include.

sara (SRE): Ellie, include orgs A, B, C (high QPS) and say timeframe 09:10–09:40 UTC.

mike (infra): Current metrics snapshot: 5xx -> 1.9% (was 7.2%), 429 -> 0.6% (was 3.4%), p95 latency 1.1s. Backlog draining.

sara (SRE): Nice. Keep throttle until backlog < 2000 inflight tokens and error rate < 0.5% for 5m.

john (platform): I’m scheduling a canary rollback of the new quota enforcement in the config pipeline with an audit entry and feature-flag gating.

sara (SRE): Next: root cause analysis timeline. Need RCA doc, owner: mike (infra), due EOD tomorrow. Also add reprioritized tasks: stronger canarying for quota policy changes, preflight on high-QPS tenants, and alert tuning to differentiate 429->retry cascades.

ellie (support): Customer comms ready draft. Will send initial outbound in 20m.

incident-bot: INC-2143 updated: status=mitigated, mitigations=[quota-revert, throttle, reduced-retries, fallback-routing, scale-up].

mike (infra): Backlog below 1200, error rate steady at 0.4%. Will start gradual scale-down in 10m.

sara (SRE): Thanks team. After-action: schedule deep-dive tomorrow with platform + infra + SRE. Assigning followups: mike->RCA, john->route rollback review, ellie->customer follow-up.

john (platform): One actionable: add a safety in the quota pipeline that blocks policy changes affecting >5% of active tenants without an explicit override.

sara (SRE): Agreed. Closing slack thread once RCA ticket created. Great response — quick rollback and targeted mitigations minimized impact. :thumbsup:

ellie (support): Noting customer replies already — some asking for SLA credit. I’ll route to CS for manual reviews.

incident-bot: Thread closed for now. Add postmortem link when ready: /incidents/INC-2143/postmortem
